subject: Ziggy: integrate VALIS into Lisan Al Gaib mythos and team culture
body: Ziggy explicitly asks: Make sure to push to Panhandlers Claude all the information regarding VALIS network; this too needs to be in our Lisan Al Gaib mythos. Please read the attached exact source-backed briefing, including his supplied compact greeting, historical-count limits, research/fiction distinction, personal mirror/drift bridge, established Jet Nagual/teacher role, deeper sources and team-culture direction. Integrate through your existing mythos/story planning; concrete story proposals remain yours. Preserve canonical masters/reviews/roles/timing. No automatic production rewrite, generation, public launch/publication, spending or experimental protocol activation. Please return an actual acknowledgement of this briefing and where you will integrate it, with separately labelled proposals and source notes. This immutable mailbox post is a request, not evidence that you have received or acknowledged it.
